%______________________________________
% Instructions and LaTeX code to copy/paste into your document, to incorporate this file into your proposal, now located at:
%
% https://github.com/pmarcum/WorPT-Work-Plan-Tool-4-proposals/blob/main/latexTableTemplates/isANONtasks/readme.md
%______________________________________
\newif\ifLandScape                 % establish a boolean variable
\def\WorPTfolder{isANONtasks} % set the folder name where WorPT files are contained
% ___________________________________________
%       Default formatting preferences
% ___________________________________________
\LandScapefalse                % default is that the landscape mode is OFF
%---- column width controls
\def\TaskWidth{3.4in}          % width of "Task" column (leftmost column)
\def\StartFinishWidth{0.2in}  % width of start/finish columns
\def\LeadWidth{0.5in}          % width of "Task Lead" column
\def\ExpertiseWidth{1.5in}     % width of "Team Expertise" column (rightmost column)
%---- table compactness controls
\def\SpaceBetweenRows{0.87}     % vertical compactness of rows
\def\SpaceBetweenColumns{2pt}  % spacing between columns
%--- control to nudge table to the left or right
\def\NudgeTable{1.2\textwidth} % adjust to help center table
%---- fix the Table Number in the caption
\def\TaskAddCounter{-1}        % corrects table number messed up by table,longtable combination)
%--- aesthetic preferences
\def\SectionColor{Blue}        % task grouping banner color
\def\SectionFontColor{White}   % task grouping title font color
\def\YearFontColor{Red}        % font color under "Y" (year) columns in Start/Finish
\def\YearQuarterLineColor{lightgray} % vertical line color in year/quarter Start/Finish columns
\def\SectionFontstyle#1{\textbf{#1}} % boldface task grouping title
\def\ColumnLabelFontstyle#1{\textbf{#1}} % boldface all the column headers
%--- table preamble definition bundled into the "T" variable
\newcolumntype{T}{
  |p{\TaskWidth}||       % title column
  p{\StartFinishWidth}!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule} % Start/year
  p{\StartFinishWidth}!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule}!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule} % Start/quarter
  p{\StartFinishWidth}!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule} % Finish/year
  p{\StartFinishWidth}|| % Finish/quarter
  p{\LeadWidth}!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule} % Task Lead column
  p{\ExpertiseWidth}|    % Expertise column
}
\newenvironment{isANONtasks}{%
\ifLandScape
  \begin{sidewaystable*}
\else
  \begin{table*}[h!]  % \begin{table} needed to make bottom table caption have same width as table
\fi
\addtocounter{table}{\TaskAddCounter}           % corrects double-counting of longtable and table combination
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{\SpaceBetweenRows} % controls vertical row separation/spacing
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{\SpaceBetweenColumns}    % controls horizontal column separation/spacing
\centerline{
\begin{minipage}{\NudgeTable}                   % increase to allow a wide table to spill into margin
\begin{longtable}{T}
%--- make colorized top banner labels, the column headers
\hline
\multirow{2}{*}{\ColumnLabelFontstyle{Task Description}} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{\ColumnLabelFontstyle{Start}} & \multicolumn{2}{!{\color{\YearQuarterLineColor}\vrule}c||}{\ColumnLabelFontstyle{Finish}} & \ColumnLabelFontstyle{Task} & \ColumnLabelFontstyle{Team}\\
\cline{2-5}
\rule{0pt}{12pt} & {\color{\YearFontColor}Y} & Q & {\color{\YearFontColor}Y} & Q & \ColumnLabelFontstyle{Lead} & \ColumnLabelFontstyle{Expertise}\\
\multicolumn{7}{|c|}{\cellcolor{\SectionColor}\color{\SectionFontColor}\SectionFontstyle{Task A: Goal A title}}\\
A1: {Task A1 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & co-I(1) & coll(1), co-I(2)\\
A2: {Task A2 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & co-I(2) & co-I(1), coll(1)\\
A3: {Task A3 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
A4: {Task A4 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & co-I(2) & coll(1), co-I(1)\\
A5: {Task A5 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & co-I(2) & co-I(1), coll(1)\\
A6: {Task A6 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & PI & co-I(2)\\
A7: {Task A7 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & PI & co-I(2)\\
\multicolumn{7}{|c|}{\cellcolor{\SectionColor}\color{\SectionFontColor}\SectionFontstyle{Task B: Goal B title}}\\
B1: {Task B1 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & co-I(2) & PI, co-I(1)\\
B2: {Task B2 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & co-I(2) & PI, co-I(1)\\
B3: {Task B3 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & co-I(2) & PI, coll(1)\\
B4: {Task B4 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
B5: {Task B5 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
B6: {Task B6 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
B7: {Task B7 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & PI & co-I(2)\\
B8: {Task B8 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & co-I(2) & co-I(1), PI\\
B9: {Task B9 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & co-I(2) & co-I(1), PI\\
\multicolumn{7}{|c|}{\cellcolor{\SectionColor}\color{\SectionFontColor}\SectionFontstyle{Task C: Goal C title}}\\
C1: {Task C1 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C2: {Task C2 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C3: {Task C3 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 3 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C4: {Task C4 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 3 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C5: {Task C5 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 4 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C6: {Task C6 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & co-I(2) & co-I(1), PI\\
C7: {Task C7 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 1 & PI & co-I(2)\\
C8: {Task C8 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}3} & 1 & PI & co-I(2), coll(1)\\
\multicolumn{7}{|c|}{\cellcolor{\SectionColor}\color{\SectionFontColor}\SectionFontstyle{Task D: Goal D title}}\\
D1: {Task D1 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}1} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 2 & PI & team\\
D2: {Task D2 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 3 & {\color{\YearFontColor}3} & 1 & PI & team\\
D3: {Task D3 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}2} & 4 & {\color{\YearFontColor}3} & 3 & PI & team\\
D4: {Task D4 title}  & {\color{\YearFontColor}3} & 2 & {\color{\YearFontColor}3} & 4 & PI & team\\
\hline
\end{longtable}
\end{minipage}}} 
{%
\ifLandScape
  \end{sidewaystable*}
\else
  \end{table*}
\fi
}
